name: indec-mcp
description: Retrieve traceable official Argentine economic statistics through INDEC MCP.

interface.longDescription: Retrieve official Argentine inflation, wage growth, Gran Buenos Aires basic basket costs, national economic activity and EPH unemployment statistics with reference periods, coverage, statistical flags and source links. Compare wages with national inflation for matching periods, distinguishing calculated real wage change from percentage-point differences. Independent service; not an INDEC product or endorsement. Missing data are not substituted and historical publication vintages are not reconstructed.
defaultPrompt: What is Argentina's latest national monthly inflation?
How much is the basic total basket per adult equivalent in Gran Buenos Aires?
How has unemployment changed across the latest available quarters?

publication.release_notes: Review draft with all six V0 tools and verified inflation, wage, basket, EMAE and unemployment mappings. Wage comparisons align reference periods and distinguish real growth from percentage-point gaps.

es-AR.subtitle: Estadísticas de Argentina
es-AR.description: Estadísticas oficiales de Argentina, consultables desde ChatGPT y Codex. Servicio independiente basado en datos oficiales del INDEC, con períodos de referencia, cobertura y fuentes. Incluye salarios y su comparación con la inflación para períodos coincidentes, distinguiendo el crecimiento real de la diferencia en puntos porcentuales. No sustituye datos faltantes ni reconstruye publicaciones históricas.
